description: This file defines the Entropy impurity measure used in Spark's MLlib for multiclass classification, including classes and objects for calculating, updating, and storing entropy-related statistics.

classes.name: Entropy
classes.description: Object for calculating entropy during multiclass classification, providing methods for entropy calculation based on label counts.

classes.name: EntropyAggregator
classes.description: Class for updating views of sufficient statistics for entropy calculation, used during model training.

classes.name: EntropyCalculator
classes.description: Class for storing and computing impurity from sufficient statistics for a specific (node, feature, bin).

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates entropy based on counts of labels and total count.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; variance calculation not supported for entropy.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Entropy object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates statistics with a new sample label, weight, and count.

methods.name: getCalculator
methods.description: Creates an EntropyCalculator for a set of statistics.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the EntropyCalculator.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts label based on maximum probability from statistics.

methods.name: prob
methods.description: Calculates probability of a given label based on statistics.
